Police Crack Down on Juvenile Gangs in Haradwada, 16 Arrested

On [date], police raided a coaching center in Haradwada and arrested 14 juvenile gang members, including two minors. The gang was allegedly involved in a ₹35 lakh (approximately $450,000 USD) extortion racket. Police claimed that the juveniles were using the coaching center as a front to carry out their illicit activities.
